which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.
but speaking truth in love, we may grow up in all things into him who is the head, Christ,
He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in all things he…

that he might sanctify it, having cleansed it by the washing of water with the word,
Take heed, therefore, to yourselves, and to all the flock, in which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers, to shepherd…

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.
translations.bsb: For the husband is the head of the wife as Christ is the head of the church, His body, of which He is the Savior.
translations.kjv: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body.
translations.asv: For the husband is the head of the wife, and Christ also is the head of the church, being himself the saviour of the body.
